decisions.reason: Polymer concrete housings are a low-cost core component of the drainage portfolio, so keeping the option open remains sensible despite no recent observations.
Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's accessible, low-profile direction, and carrying it costs little, even though its visibility has been limited.
As the flagship design product it embodies the firm's strategic focus and justifies continued commitment.
The sloped shower element supports the barrier-free renovation trend, and no evidence yet shows its value will not be realized.
The backflow basement drain addresses rising flood-protection demand and received an explicit development commitment, so its prospects remain good.
The air-admittance valve is a cheap complementary accessory that rounds out the system, so dropping it would release few resources.
